title: Unlock document {number} for editing
intro: The document returns to a draft and can be edited in full. It keeps its number; re-issuing renders and archives a new PDF and the current one is deleted.
warnSent: The document was already sent: the customer has the old version.
warnPayments: Payments are recorded on it ({paid}); they stay and count again after the re-issue.
warnRelated: Other documents refer to it (credit notes, advance documents, final invoice); they stay linked.
reasonPlaceholder: Why the issued document has to change
keptNumber: Keeps its number {number}: re-issuing takes no new one.
confirmDelete: This draft was issued as {number}. Deleting it also deletes its payments and e-mail log, and the number is not reused. Really delete it?
